chunks: He said: 'My Lord knows whatever is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He hears all and knows everything.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah knows the speech in the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm Allah's absolute omniscience, linking His hearing of all utterances to His precise knowledge of their hidden meanings and intentions. It underscores the divine attribute of 'Al-Samī‘ al-‘Alīm' as a source of comfort for the faithful, assuring that no word in the heavens or earth escapes His comprehensive awareness.
